summary: Process Templates module fully tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASSED. Frontend: 12/12 Playwright tests PASSED. All CRUD operations work correctly (Create, Read, Update, Delete). Template cards display with expand/collapse, Active/Inactive badges. Form includes auto-key generation from labels.

details: GET /api/super-admin/process-templates returns list with id, name, formula, input_fields, predefined_inputs, is_active
POST /api/super-admin/process-templates creates template with all fields including input_fields and predefined_inputs arrays
POST works with minimal fields (name, formula), defaults is_active=true
PUT /api/super-admin/process-templates/{id} updates all fields, sets updated_at
GET /api/process-templates returns only active templates for any authenticated user
PUT and DELETE return 404 for non-existent template IDs
Process Templates link visible in SuperAdmin sidebar, navigates to correct page
Page shows title 'Process Templates', description, and 'Add Template' button
Templates display as expandable cards with name, sub_industry, description, input field count, predefined count, Active/Inactive badge
Clicking card expands to show Formula (in code block), Required Input Fields table, Predefined Inputs table
Add Template button opens dialog with Basic Info, Required Input Fields, Predefined Inputs sections
Typing in Label field auto-generates Key (e.g., 'Clinker Produced' -> 'clinker_produced')
Edit button opens dialog with pre-filled data, title changes to 'Edit Process Template'
Delete button shows confirmation dialog, removes template on confirm, shows 'Template deleted' toast
Success toasts appear for create ('Template created') and delete ('Template deleted') operations
